head: 31ecd6078a0ce7c742ff59840257f984a6471a5c
scope: Native Finance payables: standalone supplier bills, Commerce fulfillment matched bills, retained source version, posted-fulfillment guard, matched draft/posted void with Commerce release, AP journals, Money snapshots, native API and desktop/mobile UI posting.

implemented.source_version: migrations/postgres/holding-write/1100_finance_invoice_source_version.sql adds finance_invoices.source_version, backfills commerce_fulfillment rows, and Finance compares it with the current fulfillment version at post time.
implemented.commerce_draft_money: packages/server-commerce/src/application/commerce.ts retains the Finance finance_invoice draft:v1 Money snapshot and sets source_version to the post-link fulfillment version.
implemented.posted_guard: packages/server-commerce/src/adapters/finance_payable_source.rs returns journal_id/completion_kind; Finance checks finance_journals.status='posted' in the same serializable unit (service completions are accepted without a goods journal).
implemented.matched_void: Finance allows commerce_fulfillment in draft/posted void; the composition calls the Commerce release port to clear the fulfillment link and bump its version. Posted void keeps the exact reversal, independent approver, period/allocation guards and receipt.
implemented.http_error: src/composition/src/finance_journal_detail_http.rs business_error returns (status, Json(...)).into_response(), preserving application/json on 4xx so the app route surfaces the native code instead of NATIVE_FINANCE_RESPONSE_INVALID.

gates.finance.rust-supplier-bill-postgres.inte: 13/13 pass in 63.45 s (source version, stale/unposted source, non-purchase, matched draft/posted void, bad-period void, HTTP 4xx content-type)
gates.sales.commerce-foreign-goods.integration: 5/5 pass; asserts the Commerce-created finance_invoice draft:v1 snapshot
gates.migration: 1100 applied to H001/H002/H003; 78 commerce invoices backfilled, 0 null commerce source_version

native_http.app_route: POST /api/v1/holdings/acme/finance/payables/invoice-e90e3892daa85e3c96632b16fe4492423f27/post returned 200 {status:posted,journalId:journal-finance-version-app-20261110} through the Finance app native client on a real Commerce-created draft with source_version 2 and a posted goods journal.
native_http.stale_source: After bumping the fulfillment version, both the app route and direct 3198 returned 409 SUPPLIER_BILL_SOURCE_CHANGED with content-type application/json; the fulfillment version was restored. Log: .scratch/dev/rust-migration/current/finance-source-version-stale-runtime.log
native_http.receipts: command_receipts has finance.supplier-bill.post for the six earlier keys and finance-version-app-20261110.
native_http.persisted: finance_invoices status=posted, source_version=2, journal source_type=invoice, exact clearing/payable/input-tax lines.

fixed_after_previous_review: Source version retention/comparison for single-source payables; null fails closed.
Posted goods-journal guard in the same serializable unit.
Matched draft/posted void with Commerce release and version bump.
HTTP 4xx content-type fix; app and direct stale-source 409 both return SUPPLIER_BILL_SOURCE_CHANGED.
remaining_blockers: Native matched post never advances the Procurement match (procurement_bill_matches.status stays invoiced), and native matched void never returns/releases it; a new match for the same receipt is blocked.

Native Finance cannot post foreign-currency Commerce purchase invoices: the clearing account is base-currency, the native account() requires invoice currency, and prepareCommerceInvoiceGoods (goods-carrying/FX journal) is not called.
Matched void of a legacy-posted FX invoice leaves commerce_invoice_goods_fx posted; the native void only reverses the invoice journal.
Consolidated matched invoices retain only the primary source version; secondary receipts are not re-validated.
No test for Procurement match lifecycle, native foreign-goods posting, release Company isolation, consolidated matched post, or post/void lock-order concurrency.

remaining: Finance payables is not certified. The re-reviewer rejected certification on the Procurement lifecycle, foreign-currency native posting and FX matched void.
The 6-subagent roster and Common frozen-bundle coordination remain absent; only reviewer/verifier subagents were used.
